Jab aasman pahata pare ga.
Aur woh apne Parwardigar ka hukum sunn kar maan le ga, aur us par lazim hai yehi kare.
Aur jab zameen ko khench diya jaye ga.
Aur us ke andar jo kuchh hai woh use bahar phink de gi aur khali hojaye gi.
Aur woh apne Parwardigar ka hukum sunn kar maan le gi, aur us par lazim hai ke yehi kare (us waqt insan ko apna anjaam maloom hojaye ga)
Ae insan ! To apne Parwardigar ke paas pahunchne tak musalsal kisi mehnat mein laga rahe ga, yahan tak ke us se jaa mile ga.
Phir jis shaks ko us ka aemaal nama us ke dayen haath mein diya jaye ga.
Us se to aasan hisab liya jaye ga.
Aur woh apne ghar walon ke paas khushi mnata hua wapas aaye ga.
Lekin woh shaks jis ko us ka aemaal nama us ki pusht ke peechhe se diya jaye ga.
Woh maut ko pukarega
Aur bharakti hui aag mein dakhil hoga.
Pehle woh apne ghar walon ke darmiyan bohat khush rehta tha.
Us ne yeh samajh rakhha tha ke woh kabhi palat kar (Allah ke samne) nahin jaye ga.
Bhala kyun nahin ? Us ka Parwardigar use yaqeeni tor par dekh raha tha.
Ab mein qasam khata hon shafaq ki.
Aur raat ki aur un tamam cheezon ki jinhen woh sameit le.
Aur chand ki jab woh bhar ko poora hojaye.
Ke tum sab ek manzil se dusri manzil ki taraf charhte jao ge.
Phir un logon ko kya hogaya hai ke woh iman nahin late ?
Aur jab un ke samne quran parha jata hai to woh sajda nahin karte ?
Bulke yeh kafir log haqq ko jhutlate hain.
Aur jo kuchh yeh jama kar rahe hain, Allah ko khoob maloom hai.
Ab tum unhein ek dardnaak azab ki khushkhabri suna do .
Albatta jo log iman le aaye hain aur unhon ne nek amal kiye hain, un ko aisa sawab mile ga jo kabhi khatam nahin hoga.
